title: Run of the canonical-bit verdict machine
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $i$ be one of $k$ work tapes, let $\alpha$ be a Boolean input word, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each work tape. Starting in the forward-pass state with the words $w$ on the tapes, after exactly $2|w(i)|+3$ steps the verdict machine has halted and its output is the single bit equal to the last bit of $w(i)$, or $1$ if $w(i)$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a work-tape index among the $k$ tapes
$w$ assigns a Boolean word to each work tape
The run begins in the forward-pass state with the specified tape words
